verdict.rationale: The evidence describes one personal, always-on dot per user. You can rename it and change its appearance, set action-handling rules, connect apps, and it keeps its own memory notes. Nothing documents building separate custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge, or sharing such an assistant with others. Personalization, memory and Slack channel access are adjacent features, not the custom-assistant build-and-share capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
